Minions are Non-Player Characters which are summoned by other characters and are under the summoner's control.

## Contents

- 3.1 Summoned by Minion Skills

- 4 Enemy Minions

## Interface[]

Minions summoned by Player Characters have health bars can be seen in the upper left of the screen. Minions can also be targeted by hovering over them, this will show their name and health bar at the top of the screen. Some minions have a random chance to spawn with a unique name.

Using the minion attack command button ("A" by default) the player can make minion prioritize attacking the enemy they are currently targeting.

Minions are affected by their summoners minion stats, which can be found in the minion stats tab of the Character Stats window for players.

## Interactions[]

Minions will typically follow their summoner and are considered allies by skill effects.

Minions will draw aggro from nearby Enemies with a higher priority than Player Characters. Minions will aggro onto nearby enemies, while aggroed they will stop following their summoner and continue to attack enemies.
